incomeFormCalcLockedHint: The calculation mode cannot change after creation; delete and create again if you need it.
incomeFormMarginHint: Default zero. Days removed from the month before multiplying by the value.
incomeFormCashAvailable: Available money (counts in the cash flow)
incomeFormCashHint: Uncheck for a benefit that is not money: it shows in the Income area, outside the cash flow.
incomeFormItemValueRequired: Enter the first value. The item needs a value to forecast.
incomeFormVacationDaysHint: Calendar days, up to 30. Default is 30.
incomeFormModeHint: Changing mode creates a new dated record. The history stays.
incomeErrAmount: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
incomeErrAmountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
incomeErrDateOrder: The exit date cannot come before the admission.
incomeErrPerson: Choose the person who owns the job.
incomeErrThirteenthOrder: The 1st 13th installment cannot come after the 2nd.
incomeErrUf: Use the two-letter state code, such as SP.
incomeErrCityNeedsUf: To use a city, enter the state.
incomeErrPayDayRequired: Enter the pay day of the item.
incomeErrPerDayKind: An item paid per business day is always an earning.
incomeErrPerDayBases: An item paid per business day stays outside the INSS, IRRF and FGTS bases.
incomeErrNotCashRecurrence: A benefit that is not available money cannot feed a recurrence.
incomeErrAccountCredit: The account cannot be a credit card.
incomeErrRecurrenceIncome: The linked recurrence must be an income.
incomeErrRecurrenceUsed: This recurrence already feeds another job or benefit.
incomeErrVacationChoose: Enter the vacation start date or only the month, not both.
incomeErrVacationTotal: Vacation days plus sold days cannot go over 30.
incomeErrTerminationExtras: The termination mode has no birthday month or expected amount.
incomeErrCalcOnlyPerDay: Margin, pay day, account and recurrence only apply to an item paid per business day.
incomeErrDateTaken: A record with this date already exists. Choose another day.
incomeErrNotFound: This record no longer exists. Refresh the screen and try again.
incomeErrConflict: The data conflicts with a record that already exists. Check the date and the recurrence.
incomeErrGeneric: Could not save. Check the data and try again.
incomeErrLoad: Could not load the data of this job.
incomeErrAmountMax: The amount is above the accepted limit.
incomeSimulatorDescription: Works out the net from the gross, or the gross that reaches a net. No job needed and nothing is saved.
incomeSimDateHint: Picks the INSS and IRRF tables. Empty means today.
incomeSimWorkedDaysHint: Optional. Empty means the whole month; the salary is prorated by the days.
incomeSimLinesHint: Earnings add to the gross; deductions come off the net. Mark the bases each earning enters.
incomeSimNoLines: No items. Only the salary goes into the calculation.
incomeSimAdvancedHint: The defaults are the ones used in the reference payslips. Change them only to compare methods.
incomeSimNotExact: The exact net cannot be reached: the lowest gross that reaches the desired value leaves {amount} extra.
incomeSimCompareHint: Same dependents, fixed items and options. The current gross is the one in force today.
incomeSimCompareNoBaseline: This job has no salary in force today, so there is nothing to compare.
incomeSimCompareOnlyNet: The comparison with the current salary applies in gross → net mode.
incomeSimRaiseFrom: Raise for {employer}: starts with the gross in force, the dependents and the fixed monthly items.
incomeSimErrOutOfReach: This net cannot be reached with these items and dependents. Check the amount and the items.
incomeSimErrInvalid: The server refused the simulation data. Check the values and try again.
incomeSimErrGeneric: Could not simulate now. Try again.
incomeCalendarDescription: Month by month, what reaches the account: salary, benefits, 13th, vacations and birthday withdrawal.
incomeCalendarPastNote: Past months show the amount calculated from the registered rules, not what was actually received. Only a recorded birthday withdrawal shows its real amount.
incomeDeleteRowMessage: This cannot be undone. Entries already posted to the statement are not deleted.
incomeCountNoMonth: This item has no payment forecast.
maxfinRealignNote: Realigning only changes the position of the row in the sheet: values, dates and descriptions are not changed.
maxfinRealignRemovedOne: {count} transaction removed from the sheet stays in Recta and takes the line the block vacates
maxfinRealignRemovedMany: {count} transactions removed from the sheet stay in Recta and take the lines the block vacates
maxfinRealignInsertedOne: {count} new row is only imported after this realignment
maxfinRealignInsertedMany: {count} new rows are only imported after this realignment
maxfinRealignMissingRequirement: Depends on a block that is not in the preview: it cannot be applied.
maxfinRealignUnsupported: This block is over the limits of a request: it stays pending.
maxfinRealignRowShiftedHint: Only moved to another line in the sheet: decided by the realignment of its block
maxfinRealignRowBlocked: Stays pending until the realignment of the block is applied
maxfinRealignFooterPendingOne: {count} shifted block will stay pending: nothing in it will be imported or replaced
maxfinRealignFooterPendingMany: {count} shifted blocks will stay pending: nothing in them will be imported or replaced
maxfinRealignNoneSelected: Select at least one transaction or one realignment.
maxfinRealignTooMany: There are more shifted blocks than the server takes at once ({max}): refresh the preview.
maxfinRealignRowShiftedDetail: Same transaction that is on line {from} today; moves to line {to} when realigned
goalsKindReserveHint: Money kept little by little, with no date to use it.
goalsKindProvisionHint: An expense with a set month (insurance, car tax): the contribution splits what is missing by the months until then.
goalsMonthlyOptionalProvision: Leave empty to compute it from what is missing.
goalsAccountHint: The money does not leave the account: it is only marked as kept.
goalsErrAccountRequired: Choose the account the money stays in.
goalsProvisionPast: The due month has passed: nothing to keep.
goalsDuplicateMessage: {name} already got a contribution this month. Keep one more?
goalsErrExceeds: The amount goes past the goal. The maximum is {amount}.
goalsErrNoAccount: Link the goal to an account before keeping money.
goalsErrNothingPlanned: Nothing planned for this month: inform the amount.
goalsFreeNegative: What is kept goes past the balance: the free money of {account} is negative ({amount}).
billsReserveDoneToast: Contribution recorded. The account balance does not change; only the free money.
